name: launchdarkly
title: LaunchDarkly
description: Browse LaunchDarkly feature flags, targeting rules, environments and recent changes without leaving Raycast
author: luarmr

commands.name: list-feature-flags
commands.title: List Feature Flags
commands.subtitle: LaunchDarkly
commands.description: List and search through your LaunchDarkly feature flags, view their details, and manage environments

commands.name: recent-changes
commands.title: Recent Changes
commands.subtitle: LaunchDarkly
commands.description: Browse the audit log of recent feature flag changes in the current project

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: LaunchDarkly API Token
preferences.description: Your personal access token for LaunchDarkly. Must be set before using the extension.

preferences.name: projectKey
preferences.title: Default Project Key
preferences.description: Project used until you pick another one with the Switch Project action (⌘⇧S). If left blank, defaults to 'default'.

preferences.name: ldApiUrl
preferences.title: LaunchDarkly Instance URL
preferences.description: Base URL used for API requests and browser links. Change only for EU (https://app.eu.launchdarkly.com) or self-hosted instances.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
